title: Missing Product Decision on Concurrent Edits (Human Checkpoint)
problem: Unclear requirement on simultaneous document edits. Two users submit changes at the same millisecond. Should the second write overwrite or throw 409 Conflict?
observations: Product specification does not define optimistic locking policy.
Stakeholder decision needed before implementing version checks.
Unclear requirement: last-write-wins vs explicit conflict resolution.
attempts: Implemented optimistic locking with version column
